verdict.rationale: Measuring detection quality and missed fraud against labelled cases is a fair question for a fraud and risk decisioning platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents labelled validation sets, outcome tagging, backtesting, or false-negative and precision/recall reporting. The evidence covers only event monitoring, workflows, the Fraud Signal ML model, health signals, and a sandbox mode that dry-runs vendor calls rather than scoring decisions against labels.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can measure detection quality and incorrect clearances against labelled validation cases
